summary: Frontend-only E2E test (mobile 390x844, IT, admin@mikilab.de) of the 2 new FASE-3 lab tools. (5) COSTO ENERGIA FORNO: math 100% correct — defaults (6kW/40min/0.30€/60%/30pz) → energia-kwh '2.40 kWh', energia-cost '€ 0.72', energia-per '€ 0.024'; power=12 → '4.80 kWh' / '€ 1.44' (doubled) and per-piece 0.048; pieces=60 → per-piece '€ 0.024' (halved); values update in real time and persist in localStorage mikilab_energia. BUT a HIGH-priority input bug: the 5 number inputs lose focus after EVERY keystroke, so typing digit-by-digit only records the first character (typed '125' in energia-power → value '1'; typed '50' in energia-minutes → '5'; document.activeElement becomes null). Only programmatic .fill() (single-shot value set) works — a real user cannot type multi-digit values. (1) COSA POSSO FARE: found via tools-search 'cosa' → capo-quicklink-cosafare → cosaposso-tool. Ingredients 'farina 0, farina integrale, lievito madre, acqua, sale, olive, noci' with scope mikilab → AI answered in ~20s: cosa-makable with 12 real recipe cards (Focaccia Integrale ai Semi, Focaccia alle Olive e Rosmarino, Focaccia Genovese, Pane Casereccio, Panino alle Olive…) with short coherent notes + images, and cosa-almost with 7 cards showing 'Manca: uvetta / mix semi / lievito di birra / semola, patata'. Scope 'personal' for admin returned 1 makable ('Pane ai Cereali — Usa farina 0 o integrale', no image), no cosa-empty needed. No console errors during the AI call; loading state ('Cerco…' spinner) and disabled-when-empty button work.

ui_bugs.issue: Inputs lose focus after each keystroke: the `Field` sub-component is DEFINED INSIDE CostoEnergia, so a new component type is created on every state change and React unmounts/remounts the <input>. Typing '125' into energia-power leaves '1', typing '50' into energia-minutes leaves '5', document.activeElement becomes null. Users cannot enter multi-digit values. Fix: move `Field` (and the `inp` class string) OUTSIDE the component, or inline the <input> markup / memoize with useCallback-free static component.

integration_issues.issue: MINOR (AI/prompt quality): a few cards are classified as 'makable' while their own note admits a missing ingredient — e.g. 'Panino alle Olive → Farina 0 e olive, lievito manca' and 'Focaccia con Pomodorini Secchi e Origano → Farina 0, mancano solo pomodorini' appear in cosa-makable instead of cosa-almost. Consider tightening the prompt so anything with a missing ingredient goes to `almost`.

issues: Suffix labels (kW/MIN/€/KWH) sit on top of the number and overlap the browser's native number spinner arrows when the field is focused (visible in the 'MIN' field), slightly clipping the text.
Personal recipes without image_url render a plain empty grey square; a small icon/initial placeholder would look better.

action_items: HIGH: fix focus loss in CostoEnergia.jsx by hoisting the `Field` component out of the render body (single blocking bug found).
Optional: tighten the what-can-i-make prompt so recipes whose note mentions a missing ingredient are placed in `almost`, not `makable`.
Optional: avoid suffix/spinner overlap in the energia number inputs (add pr-12 and appearance-none).
critical_code_review_comments: CostoEnergia.jsx L30-38: component defined inside a component → remount on every keystroke (React anti-pattern). Same pattern should be audited in other new tools.

CosaPosso.jsx: catch block swallows the error object; log/inspect status so a 402/403 paywall or 500 can be distinguished from an empty result (currently any failure shows the generic 'Ricerca non riuscita').
CosaPosso.jsx: the same data-testid 'cosa-empty' is used for both 'no results' and 'request failed' — split ids for clearer testing.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all functional flows pass; 1 HIGH input-focus bug in Costo Energia)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Tools are reached via nav-tab-maestro → tools-search (type 'energia' / 'cosa') → capo-quicklink-<id>; go back with the 'Torna agli strumenti' button. The AI call /api/recipes/what-can-i-make answers in ~15-25s. Because of the remount bug, use page.fill() (not keyboard.type) for energia inputs until it is fixed. Admin DOES have 1 personal recipe ('Pane ai Cereali'), so cosa-empty is not reachable with the admin account for scope=personal.
rca_of_the_issue: Costo Energia focus loss: `const Field = ({...}) => (...)` is declared inside CostoEnergia, so every setState creates a brand-new function identity; React treats it as a different element type and unmounts/remounts the DOM input, discarding focus and caret. Repro: open energia tool, click energia-power, type '125' → field shows '1'. Fix: hoist Field to module scope and pass value/onChange as props.
